title: Shell cache permission failure
l0: Shell failed when opening the opencode cache.
l1: When shell reports EACCES for /tmp/opencode-cache/index.json, fix directory ownership before retrying.

title: Run billing migrations in stub mode
l0: Billing migrations need stubbed Stripe mode locally.
l1: Before running billing integration tests, set TEST_STRIPE_MODE=stub and use bun test packages/billing.

title: Keep legacy search aliases
l0: Search rollout keeps legacy aliases during tenant migration.
l1: Do not delete old index aliases until beta tenants finish migration; use the compatibility adapter instead.

title: Region-sensitive OpenRouter memory model
l0: Memory LLM tests use minimax by default due regional availability.
l1: Set OPENCODE_MEMORY_LLM_TEST_MODEL when OpenRouter region availability changes.
